_comment: Workbook exercise zone-reheat-overcooling (docs/workbook/zone-reheat-overcooling.md): the lbnl-fpu template's South-zone boxes (PFPU__<run>, the box every fault is imposed on -- see mappings/lbnl_fpu.json) with the reheat and overcooling rules of PNNL chapter 7 added. airflow_tracking and unmet_setpoint_hours are the dataset template's (the controller's active airflow setpoint VAV_PM_CFM_S_SP is trended, so a stuck damper shows as airflow off its setpoint). reheat_penalty reads the controller's reheat demand (RH_VLV_DM_S) against the AHU supply air entering the box (SA_TEMP, mapped as mixed_air_temp); overcooling_min_flow reads the zone against its cooling setpoint while the box sits at its airflow setpoint with the damper at or below 30%. Defaults throughout (weekday 07-18 occupancy, the rules' own thresholds): the point is to compare each faulted run with the fault-free one, not to tune. reheat_minimization_g36 is left out for the template's reason (the trended setpoint is the active one, not the design maximum, and G36 dual-maximum logic is for single-duct boxes); reheat_capacity_shortfall is the zone-reheat-saturated exercise's. Hourly resample: a year of 15-minute data.
